title: Average sensor reading
hints: An average is the sum divided by how many there are. Handle the empty case first, since you can't divide by zero.
Sum the readings in an `int` loop as usual. The trap is the division: `sum / count` is whole-number division and drops the `.5`. Convert to `double` first: `(double)sum / (double)count`.
`if (count == 0) return 0.0; int sum = 0; for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) sum += readings[i]; return (double)sum / (double)count;`
